# Vector Math

Calculates positions, directions and distances from three-part values.

`lfs.vector_math` · Utilities

## How to use

Use Scale to resize an offset or Distance to compare two positions.  
Length, Distance and Dot use the Value output; other operations use Vector.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | `A` | lfs.vector | [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | First three-part value in the units of your calculation. The default is (0, 0, 0). |
| B | `B` | lfs.vector | [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Second three-part value in the units of your calculation. The default is (0, 0, 0). |
| Scale | `Scale` | lfs.float | 1 | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Multiplier used by the Scale operation. 1 keeps A unchanged, 0 gives zero, and −1 reverses the direction. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Vector | `Vector` | lfs.vector | — | — | Resulting X, Y and Z values, in the units of your calculation. |
| Value | `Value` | lfs.float | — | — | Resulting number, in the units of your calculation. Connect it to a compatible numeric input. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Operation | `operation` | enum | add | add; subtract; multiply; scale; length; distance; dot; normalise | Vector calculation. Add is the default; Length, Distance and Dot produce a Value instead of a Vector. |
